title: Product Liability
description: Responsibility of a product manufacturer or seller to compensate for harm caused by a defective product or service

content.legal_definition: the responsibility of a product manufacturer or product seller, of any product or service, to compensate for any harm caused to a consumer by such defective product manufactured or sold or by deficiency in services relating thereto
content.plain_language: when a company that makes or sells a product is responsible for paying for any harm it causes to a consumer because it was defective or didn't work as promised
examples: A company selling a defective phone that explodes and injures someone may be liable for the harm caused
A manufacturer of a faulty medical device that causes health problems may be responsible for compensating the affected consumers
non_examples: A consumer misusing a product and getting injured is not an example of product liability
A company providing a service that is not defective, but the consumer is not satisfied with it, is not an example of product liability
